title: 5-HT2A receptors in layer 5 pyramidal neurons mediate the neuroplastic but not the hallucinogenic effects of psilocybin
title_zh: 5-HT2A受体在层5锥体神经元中介止幻但非致幻效应的裸盖菇素
abstract: It is unclear how serotonin 2A receptors (5-HT2ARs) in cortical layer 5 pyramidal neurons differentially contribute to psilocybin-induced hallucinations versus neuroplasticity. Here we show that psilocybin promotes synapse formation and maturation while accelerating the elimination of pre-existing synapses. Cell type-specific manipulation further demonstrated that 5-HT2AR signaling in cortical layer 5 pyramidal neurons is necessary and sufficient for psilocybin-induced synaptic remodeling but dispensable for the head-twitch response, a rodent proxy of hallucination. Psilocybin promotes and stabilizes new connections between neurons in the mouse cerebral cortex, especially after stress. Baker et al. show that 5-HT2A receptor signaling in layer 5 pyramidal neurons mediates this effect but is not required for a mouse behavioral proxy of hallucinations.
abstract_zh: 裸盖菇素如何在皮层层5锥体神经元中的5-HT2A受体（5-HT2AR） differentially 贡献于致幻与神经可塑性仍不清楚。本研究显示，裸盖菇素促进突触形成和成熟，同时加速现有突触的消除。细胞类型特异性操作进一步证明，5-HT2AR在层5锥体神经元中的信号传导对裸盖菇素诱导的突触重塑是必要且充分的，但对啮齿类头抽动反应（作为致幻的啮齿类代理）是不必要的。Baker等人表明，5-HT2A受体信号在层5锥体神经元中介此效应，但不需要于啮齿类致幻行为代理。
